ModMetaData.name: RimMT V0.9.3-T34D.2.3 Clean Idle Fix
ModMetaData.author: Allen / Rimworld-Project
ModMetaData.description: Cleaned T34-D.2.3 performance baseline for RimWorld 1.5. Retains T34-B snapshot candidate planning and selected live-authoritative search accelerators. Removes live WorkGiver validation on worker threads and all validator, Reachability and reservation result replay that could turn a valid job search into Idle. Final WorkGiver validation, Reachability, reservations and job selection execute live on the main thread.
